purpose: Criticize someone for not even doing an expected action.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
Vます stem + もしないで
Do not call it impossible without even checking.
He left without even saying goodbye.
She criticized the book without even reading it.
formation: Vます stem + もしないで
restrictions: Emphasizes omission before another action or judgment.
mistake: The stem is required: 調べもしないで, not 調べるもしないで.
